title: Run DFT calculations for doping calibration
action: Perform plane-wave DFT calculations (PBE functional) for a free-standing monolayer HfTe2 with in-plane lattice constant 3.967 Å and vacuum spacing ≥20 Å. At several added electron surface densities (e.g., 0, 1e13, 2e13, …, 8e13 electrons/cm²), compute the Fermi energy and record the shift relative to the neutral case.

title: Produce calibration CSV
action: Extract the Fermi energy shifts from the DFT results at each doping level and compile a CSV table with two columns: 'density (electrons/cm^2)' and 'fermi_shift (eV)'.
description: Calibration table mapping added electron surface density to Fermi energy shift for free-standing monolayer HfTe2.
output_schema: Two columns: 'density (electrons/cm^2)' (float, units: electrons/cm^2) and 'fermi_shift (eV)' (float, units: eV). Header row required. At least 5 data rows.
